We are seeking an experienced Low Voltage Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of low voltage installation projects, including structured cabling, security systems, access control, CCTV, audio/visual, and network infrastructure. job.title: Data Center Quality Assurance and Quality Control Coordinator
job.description:
Data Center Quality Assurance and Quality Control Coordinator
Spartanburg,SC

Join Next Level Technician as a Data Center Quality Assurance and Quality Control Coordinator in Spartanburg,SC! Earn $35-$40+ /hr., based on experience and skillset. Enjoy weekly pay, benefits, and steady work with a national leader. Apply now!

Job Summary:
Support the implementation of quality control activities for data center construction projects. Assist the Quality Control Manager in maintaining quality documentation, coordinating inspections, tracking deficiencies, and verifying that work is performed in accordance with project specifications, customer requirements, industry standards, and company expectations.

Work closely with project teams, subcontractors, customers, and commissioning personnel to help deliver high-quality installations and successful project turnover.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Assist in implementing project-specific quality control plans, procedures, and inspection processes.

  • Perform field inspections and walkdowns to verify workmanship, installation quality, and adherence to approved construction documents.

  • Maintain and update inspection and test plans (ITPs), inspection checklists, and project quality records.

  • Schedule and coordinate quality inspections with subcontractors, customers, owner's representatives, third-party inspectors, and commissioning teams.

  • Assist in reviewing drawings, specifications, submittals, and RFIs to identify quality requirements.

  • Log, track, and follow up on non-conformance reports (NCRs), punch list items, deficiencies, and corrective actions through closure.

  • Communicate quality issues to field personnel and subcontractors and verify that corrective actions are completed.

  • Document inspection results with field notes, photographs, and reports, and keep records organized in the document control system.

  • Support testing, startup, commissioning, and turnover activities, including tracking test results and open items.

  • Compile and verify as-built documentation, test reports, quality records, turnover packages, and closeout documentation for completeness and accuracy.

  • Prepare quality status reports, deficiency logs, and metrics for the Quality Control Manager and project leadership.

  • Help identify quality trends and recurring issues and recommend improvements.

  • Assist with quality-related training and orientation for project personnel and subcontractors.

  • Support customer audits, internal audits, and compliance reviews as required.

  • Promote a culture of quality and accountability on the project site.

Job Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:


  • Working knowledge of construction quality processes, inspection procedures, and quality documentation.

  • Familiarity with data center construction, mission-critical infrastructure, or commissioning processes preferred.

  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, submittals, and technical documentation.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and thorough documentation.

  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills.

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and escalate them appropriately.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with field crews, subcontractors, inspectors, and customers.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and construction management/document control software.

  • Basic understanding of applicable building codes, industry standards, and quality assurance methodologies.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced construction environment.

Education and Experience:


  • High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate's or bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in construction quality control, quality assurance, inspection, document control, commissioning, or a related field required.

  • Experience supporting mission-critical, data center, electrical, telecommunications, or large-scale commercial construction projects preferred.

  • Industry certifications related to quality management, construction inspection, or commissioning (or willingness to pursue them) are preferred.

Physical Requirements


  • Ability to work in office and active construction site environments.

  • Frequent walking, standing, climbing stairs, and navigating job sites.

  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.

  • Must be willing to travel as needed and wear required PPE.

  • May require extended hours during inspections, commissioning, and key project milestones.

Why Work with Next Level Technician in Spartanburg?


  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week

  • Competitive Wages: $35–$40+/hr. based on experience and skillset

  • Overtime Opportunities: Additional hours available when project and service needs require

job.title: Safety Coordinator- Data Centers
job.description:
Safety Coordinator – Data Center Construction

Fort Wayne, IN

$37.00–$40.00/hour | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity

Next Level Technician is hiring an experienced Safety Coordinator for a long-term opportunity supporting a large-scale data center construction project in Fort Wayne, IN.

This position is ideal for a safety professional with a strong commercial construction, electrical, data center, or industrial background who is comfortable being hands-on in the field and working directly with technicians, contractors, foremen, and project leadership.

The right candidate will be responsible for helping maintain a safe jobsite, conducting daily safety inspections, identifying and correcting hazards, supporting safety training, and ensuring crews are following OSHA and site-specific safety requirements.

Job Type: Full-Time
Pay: $37.00–$40.00/hour
Location: Fort Wayne, IN
Schedule: Monday–Friday / Day Shift

Responsibilities

  • Conduct daily jobsite safety walks and inspections
  • Monitor construction activities to identify unsafe conditions and potential hazards
  • Ensure employees and subcontractors are following OSHA, company, and site-specific safety requirements
  • Lead daily safety meetings, toolbox talks, stretch-and-flex activities, and safety orientations
  • Review and assist with Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Activity Hazard Analyses (AHAs), and other safety documentation
  • Document safety observations, incidents, near misses, and corrective actions
  • Assist with incident investigations and root-cause analysis
  • Work closely with project managers, foremen, general contractors, and trade partners
  • Coach field personnel on proper PPE, safe work practices, fall protection, ladder safety, electrical safety, and other jobsite requirements
  • Monitor contractor and subcontractor safety performance
  • Assist with emergency response procedures and site safety planning
  • Maintain accurate safety records and daily reports
  • Help ensure compliance with OSHA 29 CFR 1926 and applicable site requirements
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve the overall safety culture on the project

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is comfortable in the field and knows construction safety.

Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:

  • Data center construction
  • Commercial construction
  • Electrical construction
  • Low-voltage / telecommunications construction
  • Industrial construction
  • Mission-critical construction
  • General contractor or subcontractor safety
  • Construction site safety management
  • Electrical safety / NFPA 70E
  • Fall protection and elevated work
  • Confined space
  • Crane, rigging, or lifting operations

The ideal candidate is someone who can communicate effectively with field personnel, identify issues before they become incidents, and confidently address unsafe conditions when they see them.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of construction safety experience preferred
  • OSHA 30 Required
  • First Aid/CPR certification preferred
  • Strong understanding of OSHA construction standards
  • Experience conducting jobsite safety inspections
  • Experience with JHAs/AHAs and safety documentation
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Comfortable working on active construction sites throughout the day
  • Ability to stand, walk, climb ladders, and navigate active construction environments
  • Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with project leadership
  • Reliable transportation to and from the jobsite

  • OSHA 510
  • CHST
  • ASP
  • CSP
  • First Aid/CPR
  • NFPA 70E
  • Fall Protection
  • Competent Person certifications

job.title: Low Voltage Cable Technician
job.description:
Low Voltage Cable Technician – Structured Cabling | Greater Milwaukee - Brookfield, WI

Join Next Level Technician as a Low Voltage Cable Technician in Greater Milwaukee, Brookfield, WI! Earn $20-$24/hr, enjoy weekly pay, benefits, and steady work with a national leader. Apply now!

Responsibilities:

  • Pull, terminate, dress, and label CAT5e/CAT6, voice, data, security, paging, nurse call, and fiber optic systems
  • Test installed cable (Fluke or similar testers)
  • Punch down voice and data jacks
  • Perform punch-downs, cross-connects, fiber termination, and fiber splicing according to industry standards and color codes
  • Install racks, patch panels, cable trays, cabinets, MDF/IDF, etc.
  • Work safely on ladders/lifts (comfortable with heights)
  • Read and interpret blueprints/system layouts
  • Install and support access control, CCTV, audio/visual, security, paging, and nurse call systems

Requirements:

  • 2+ years commercial/industrial low voltage experience
  • Experience with structured cabling, voice/data, or security systems preferred
  • Experience with fiber optic installation, termination, and/or splicing preferred
  • BICSI, Lift, and OSHA certifications a plus
  • Basic hand tools and PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, hi-vis vest, steel-toe boots)
  • Working knowledge of telecom/data networks
  • Willingness to travel to job sites within Wisconsin as needed
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to bend, lift, twist, turn, crawl into tight spaces, frequently climb and work from 6'+ ladders and lifts, perform extended overhead cabling/wiring, and load, unload, and move materials up to 50 lbs. without assistance.


Why Work with Next Level Technician in Brookfield, WI?

  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week, no waiting
  • Competitive Wages: $20-$24/hr based on your experience and skillset
  • PTO, medical benefits, sign-on & referral bonuses
  • Career Growth: Advance through BICSI-certified training and real project experience
  • Dedicated recruiter support with deep knowledge of Brookfield's low voltage industry
  • National Footprint: Be part of a team that is respected across Wisconsin and the U.S.


About Next Level Technician

job.title: Electrical Superintendent
job.description:
Electrical Superintendent – Mission Critical Construction


Pay: $85,000 - $100,000 based on experience

Join Next Level Technician as an Electrical Superintendent overseeing the full conveyance scope on a large-scale mission-critical construction project. We're looking for an experienced field leader who can own manpower, production, scheduling, QA/QC, and GC coordination across a complex, fast-moving jobsite.

This is a true Superintendent position, not a working tools-on role. You'll be responsible for leading the field operation, managing Leads and crews, and ensuring the conveyance scope stays safe, productive, documented, and on schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the entire conveyance scope for the project
  • Manage Lead Technicians, field crews, daily manpower, and resource allocation
  • Plan and sequence work based on project schedules, priorities, and available work fronts
  • Coordinate directly with the General Contractor regarding access, sequencing, constraints, and other trades
  • Lead daily field planning and ensure crews have clear direction and achievable production goals
  • Read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and pathway layouts
  • Own field production and ensure project milestones are achieved
  • Monitor installation quality and oversee QA/QC
  • Identify schedule risks, field constraints, and potential conflicts before they impact production
  • Coordinate resolution of field issues with Project Management, Leads, the GC, and other trades
  • Maintain accurate documentation throughout the project
  • Participate in daily GC coordination meetings and communicate project status, constraints, and upcoming needs
  • Hold field leadership accountable for safety, quality, productivity, and documentation

Drawings & Digital Tools

Strong digital construction management experience is required for this position.

The Electrical Superintendent must be proficient with PlanGrid and Procore and comfortable managing project information directly from a tablet in the field.

Responsibilities include:

  • Pulling and verifying the current drawing revision before work is released to crews
  • Ensuring Leads and Technicians are never working from superseded drawings
  • Reviewing and managing RFIs and constraint items
  • Red-lining drawings as field conditions change
  • Keeping as-built drawings current as work progresses — not weeks later
  • Marking up drawings and attaching supporting field photos
  • Tracking and closing punch-list and constraint items
  • Maintaining accurate documentation for completed work
  • Using digital documentation to communicate changes and expectations to field leadership

Requirements

  • Proven Superintendent experience on large-scale commercial, industrial, data center, or mission-critical construction projects
  • Data center or major industrial/commercial construction experience required
  • Strong understanding of conveyance and pathway installations
  • Experience managing multiple Leads and field crews simultaneously
  • Strong manpower planning and labor allocation experience
  • Ability to read and interpret complex construction drawings and specifications
  • Proven experience managing project schedules, sequencing, and production
  • Strong QA/QC background
  • PlanGrid and Procore proficiency required
  • Comfortable working from a tablet and managing digital project documentation daily
  • Experience with RFIs, constraint logs, red-lines, as-builts, and punch-list management
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to operate successfully in a GC-led construction environment
  • Comfortable participating in daily coordination meetings and working alongside multiple trades

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can run the jobsite operation — not just supervise individual technicians.

You should be comfortable walking into a large project, reviewing the prints and schedule, determining manpower needs, sequencing multiple work fronts, directing your Leads, coordinating constraints with the GC, and holding the entire field team accountable for production and quality.

Attention to documentation is equally important. Working from a superseded drawing can create major cost and schedule impacts, so this Superintendent must have strong processes for ensuring the entire team is always working from the latest project information.

job.title: AV Field Engineer
job.description:
AV Field Engineer – Audio Visual Systems
Houston, TX

Join Next Level Technician as an AV Field Engineer in Houston, TX! Earn $35-$50/hr., enjoy weekly pay, benefits, and steady work with a national leader in low voltage staffing. If you're an experienced AV professional with strong commissioning, troubleshooting, and systems integration experience, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, commission, and troubleshoot commercial AV systems, including video conferencing systems, digital displays, projectors, LED walls, interactive displays, audio systems, microphones, speakers, matrix switchers, equipment racks, and control processors.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, one-line diagrams, riser diagrams, floor plans, and engineering drawings.
  • Configure and troubleshoot AV control systems, DSPs, network switches, and network-connected AV-over-IP devices.
  • Test, commission, and verify complete system functionality prior to project turnover.
  • Perform software updates and firmware upgrades on AV equipment, and troubleshoot hardware, software, and networking issues.
  • Provide technical support during system startup and customer acceptance testing.
  • Coordinate with Project Managers, programmers, subcontractors, and customers throughout project execution.
  • Complete project documentation, punch lists, as-built documentation, and service reports.
  • Ensure installations comply with manufacturer specifications, project requirements, and company quality standards.
  • Conduct QA/QC walks to verify installation quality and code compliance.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to field team members.
  • Follow OSHA regulations and company safety procedures.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of commercial AV installation, integration, or field engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience installing and commissioning commercial AV systems.
  • Strong understanding of AV signal flow, audio systems, video distribution, video conferencing, AV-over-IP technologies, and structured cabling.
  • Experience with equipment racks, DSP programming adjustments, matrix switchers, network switches, HDMI distribution, and fiber optic infrastructure.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex AV system issues independently.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, a valid driver's license with a clean driving record, and the ability to travel to project sites throughout the Greater Houston area and surrounding regions as needed.
  • CTS (Certified Technology Specialist) certification issued by AVIXA preferred.
  • Experience with Crestron, Extron, Q-SYS, Biamp, Shure, Logitech, Poly, Cisco Webex, Microsoft Teams Rooms, or Zoom Rooms.

  • Proficiency with cable certification testers and audio/network analysis tools (e.g., Fluke, Dante Controller).
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.; work safely from ladders, scaffolding, and aerial lifts; bend, kneel, crawl, climb, and stand for extended periods; distinguish wire and cable colors; and work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.

Commercial AV integration experience required — residential/home theater experience alone does not qualify.
